This is the new Lamborghini Revuelto SV! It takes Lamborghini’s already-very-fast 1001hp Revuelto, and applies the SV (aka “super fast”) treatment to it. That means more power, more downforce, stickier tyres and better brakes, to create a 1050hp V12 supercar. It’s Lambo’s Final Boss, but is it wild enough to live up to the SV badge?
Lamborghini Revuelto SV
Tom Ford
